page.title: Battle.net Community Developer Portal
page.description: Welcome to the Battle.net Community Developer Portal: the place where you can integrate with our APIs and connect with other developers from around the world to craft best-in-class experiences for your community.

page.title: Documentation
page.description: Explore our APIs and discover the powerful experiences you can craft. Read our guides to learn how to integrate and get started accessing our data.
page.heroDescription: Learn how to access our data.
page.cardDescription: Read our Getting Started guide and learn how to use OAuth to access our APIs. Discover how our APIs work, and all the amazing things you can do.

page.title: Getting Started
page.cardDescription: Learn how to set up your OAuth client ID and secret, manage your clients, and make API requests.

page.title: Using OAuth
page.cardDescription: Learn about Battle.net APIs OAuth requirements and libraries. Understand authorization code and client credential flows for your sites.

page.title: Client Credentials Flow
page.cardDescription: Details about integrating the OAuth2 client credentials flow.

page.title: Authorization Code Flow
page.cardDescription: Details about integrating the OAuth2 authorization code flow.

page.title: Support for OpenID Connect
page.cardDescription: Details about Battle.net OAuth Provider support for OpenID Connect (OIDC).

page.title: Example Applications
page.cardDescription: Example applications demonstrating how to use OAuth in various languages.

page.title: Game Data APIs
page.cardDescription: Get the basics on how Game Data APIs work to get information like Mythic Dungeon leaderboards.

page.title: Community APIs
page.cardDescription: Read about Community APIs and how they get information about player profiles and other data.

page.title: Regionality and APIs
page.cardDescription: Discover the ways Battle.net uses region-based concepts to deliver game data to consumers.

page.title: Battle.net
